label: PF Backlog 613
title: EPIC: Agents & Artifact Registry (agent definitions/specs + artifact contracts: format/schema/size/budget/slider/kind)
body: Umbrella for the agent layer: agent definitions/specs AND the Artifact Contract Registry giving each agent/stage its artifact format/sections, size budget, project-size slider, project-kind selection, required-vs-optional sections, counts, and structured validation - bounded by construction, fail-closed.

brief.problem: Bounded-by-construction generation: each agent/stage is GIVEN its artifact format/sections, a size budget, a project-size slider, project-kind selection, required-vs-optional sections, counts, and structured schema validation; output is validated post-generation (fail-closed/compress, never truncate). Builds on the Artifact Contract Registry (PR #98).
brief.what_adds: EPIC: Generation proportionality & budget guardrails (artifact contracts: format/size/budget/slider/kind + enforcement)

objective: Every agent/stage is defined and produces its artifacts against a given, versioned contract (format+budget+slider+kind), enforced post-generation.
